about: Belinda Hanson is a top-rated attorney practicing in the San Mateo, California area. Providing legal representation in California for a variety of different issues, Belinda Hanson was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Belinda Hanson attended law school. Belinda Hanson was enrolled at Santa Clara University School of Law. She earned a juris doctor degree in 1990. Belinda Hanson was admitted to the practice of law in 1990.

Attorneys like Belinda Hanson are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Belinda Hanson represents clients with Family Law issues.
